title: Initial Bit Decomposition of a Doubled Encoding
statement: For every pair of binary words $x,u$, every natural number $q$, and every bit $b$, the condition that $x$ has the doubled encoding of $b::u$ starting at position $q$—meaning each bit of $b::u$ occurs twice at its prescribed positions and is followed by the delimiter $01$—holds if and only if $x$ has $b$ at positions $q$ and $q+1$ and has the doubled encoding of $u$ starting at position $q+2$.
